## Functions

### `Figure`

```ts
Figure(props: FigureProps): Html
```

Media with a caption, for pages that are not prose.

## Types

### `FigureAlign`

`wide` bleeds to the container's edges; `center` is a centred block.

- `"start"`
- `"center"`
- `"end"`
- `"wide"`

### `FigureSize`

The figure's maximum inline size.

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `FigureProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | `Html` | yes | An image, a video, a chart. |
| `caption` | `string | Html` |  |  |
| `align` | `FigureAlign` |  |  |
| `size` | `FigureSize` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A captioned screenshot, centred

```ts
Figure({
  align: "center",
  size: "md",
  media: html`<img src="/media/docs/billing.png" alt="The billing page" width="800" height="450">`,
  caption: html`<strong>Figure 2.</strong> The billing page after the redesign.`,
})
```

```html
<figure class="figure figure--center figure--md">
  <div class="figure__media">
    <img src="/media/docs/billing.png" alt="The billing page" width="800" height="450">
  </div>
  <figcaption class="figure__caption">
    <strong>Figure 2.</strong>
    The billing page after the redesign.
  </figcaption>
</figure>
```

### A full-width chart

`wide` drops the rounded corners so the media meets the container's edges.

```ts
Figure({
  align: "wide",
  media: html`<img src="/media/reports/q3.svg" alt="Revenue by month, Q3" width="1200" height="400">`,
  caption: "Revenue by month, Q3.",
})
```

```html
<figure class="figure figure--wide">
  <div class="figure__media">
    <img src="/media/reports/q3.svg" alt="Revenue by month, Q3" width="1200" height="400">
  </div>
  <figcaption class="figure__caption">Revenue by month, Q3.</figcaption>
</figure>
```
